name: Production Strategy Selection
purpose: Choose the workflow profile appropriate to genre, runtime, interaction complexity, dialogue density and risk.
scope: Bounded studio_governance capability; must operate on versioned structured artifacts.
out_of_scope: final approval outside owner decision rights
procedure: Validate authoritative inputs specifically required for production_strategy_selection.
Execute the bounded operation: Choose the workflow profile appropriate to genre, runtime, interaction complexity, dialogue density and risk.
Apply production_strategy_selection-specific decision rules and record evidence/uncertainty.
Validate the named output against its workflow contract and creative invariants.
Record provenance and hand off to production_librarian.
decision_rules: do not invent missing upstream decisions
prefer local repair over global rewrite when scope is local
escalate when confidence is low and impact is high
creative_invariants: preserve approved premise/theme/character/world/visual invariants unless work order explicitly authorizes change
examples: Run production_strategy_selection on fixture/project artifact and emit a scored result.
counterexamples: Do not ask production_strategy_selection to "make the whole film better" or override another department.
